statement: The CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one entry with vendorProject SAP and a dateAdded value between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-16.
resolution: TRUE if the CISA KEV JSON feed contains an entry whose vendorProject field is SAP and whose dateAdded falls between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-16 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry with vendorProject SAP carries a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The CISA KEV catalog adds at least one VMware vCenter Server entry, listed under vendorProject VMware or Broadcom, with a dateAdded value between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-13.
resolution: TRUE if a KEV entry naming VMware vCenter Server in its product field carries a dateAdded between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-13 inclusive.
failure_condition: No KEV entry naming VMware vCenter Server carries a dateAdded inside the window.

statement: The ICE Brent Crude front-month futures contract settles at or above 100.00 US dollars per barrel on at least one trading day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if ICE publishes a front-month Brent settlement price of 100.00 or higher for any trading day inside the window.
failure_condition: Every ICE front-month Brent settlement inside the window prints below 100.00 dollars per barrel.

statement: The FRED series DGS10 records a daily value at or above 5.00 percent on at least one business day between 2026-08-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if any non-missing DGS10 observation dated inside the window is 5.00 or greater as published in the FRED series.
failure_condition: Every non-missing DGS10 observation inside the window prints below 5.00 percent.

statement: A NATO member state formally requests Article 4 consultations between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if NATO publishes a statement confirming Article 4 consultations were invoked, and Reuters and the Associated Press both report the request, dated inside the window.
failure_condition: No member state requests Article 4 consultations inside the window.

statement: Iranian or US forces board, seize, or fire on a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz or Gulf of Oman between 2026-08-17 and 2026-10-15.
resolution: TRUE if two of Reuters, AP, or AFP report the incident and either an Iranian state outlet or a US Central Command statement acknowledges it.
failure_condition: No boarding, seizure, or weapons fire against a commercial vessel occurs in those waters inside the window.

statement: A UK statutory instrument amending the zero emission vehicle mandate regime is published on legislation.gov.uk with a made date between 2026-08-17 and 2026-12-18.
resolution: TRUE if legislation.gov.uk lists a UK statutory instrument amending the zero emission vehicle mandate regime with a made date inside the window.
failure_condition: No such statutory instrument carries a made date inside the window on legislation.gov.uk.

statement: The UK Electoral Commission publishes a concluded investigation outcome naming Reform UK on its enforcement register between 2026-08-17 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: TRUE if the Electoral Commission enforcement outcomes register carries an entry naming Reform UK with a published date inside the window.
failure_condition: The enforcement register carries no concluded outcome naming Reform UK dated inside the window.

statement: The World Health Organization declares the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern between 2026-08-17 and 2026-12-15.
resolution: TRUE if WHO publishes an IHR Emergency Committee statement or Director-General declaration designating this outbreak a PHEIC, dated inside the window.
failure_condition: WHO issues no PHEIC declaration covering this outbreak inside the window.

statement: Luigi Mangione enters a guilty plea to at least one count in the New York state prosecution between 2026-08-17 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the New York state court docket in that prosecution records a guilty plea entered by the defendant on a date inside the window.
failure_condition: The state docket records no guilty plea entered inside the window.
